rootCause: P0 x3 in masyu/index.html: (1) genLoop exhaustive randomized DFS is exponential — on 9x9+ grids (seed 501+, levels 21-30) it never returned, freezing the game permanently on level start; fixed with a node budget + rectangle fallback. (2) The rectangle fallback duplicated three corner cells, emitting degenerate self-edges (e.g. '1,5-1,5') that can never satisfy validateSolution; fixed ranges to visit each perimeter cell once. (3) Pearls were placed from raw turn/straight classification without enforcing the full masyu win-check rules (black: straight continuation beyond both arms; white: adjacent turn), so the generator's own solution failed validateSolution — every level was unwinnable even drawing the exact solution; now only rule-satisfiable cells become pearls.
